channel.title: Garden Rescue
channel.desc: Charlie Dimmock revisits some of her favourite gardens from over the years. In Chester, she returns to see how Michelle and Andrew's space has grown into a stunning jungle garden. In Cambourne, she catches up with Becca and Marcus, whose plot blends Scottish and Australian influences. Finally, in Petersfield, Charlie discovers how Jeannie and Norman's tranquil garden has become a serene country retreat with a touch of oriental flair.
